title: Usogui
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Master gambler Baku Madarame, 'the Lie Eater', plays life-or-death wagers against ruthless opponents alongside his protege Takaomi Kaji and bodyguard Marco. His aim is to take control of Kakerou, an underground organization whose referees enforce gambling debts even when the stakes are players' lives, while fighting the rival criminal group IDEAL. It ran for 49 volumes.
life_message: It holds up nerve, wit and seeing through lies as what lets a person survive and rule in a ruthless world.

delivery.evidence: No source addresses delivery; cunning-and-nerve theme carried by the gambles (to verify).
delivery.note: Survival through wit is shown through the gambles rather than stated as a lesson.

winners_losers: The cleverest liar wins: Baku outwits rivals in Kakerou and IDEAL, and the less perceptive lose money, freedom or life. The story's sympathy goes to cunning and nerve rather than conventional morality.
